kids: Collect a candy cane from Santa
Meet the elves on the sand
site: Fort Lauderdale Beach Park, 1100 Seabreeze Blvd
about: The city calls this Santa Claus' traditional candy giveaway along Fort Lauderdale Beach, held each December.
Santa and his elves start at Fort Lauderdale Beach Park and head north, spreading holiday cheer and handing out candy canes along the way.
The city's parks site lists the 2026 visit for Tuesday, December 8, at 12:30 PM, with Fort Lauderdale Beach Park as the starting point.
The beach park sits at 1100 Seabreeze Blvd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316, and the city lists it among its public beach facilities.
The parks department keeps a video from the 2024 visit on the event page, so families can preview the route and the crowd before they go.
A photo album from the December 9, 2025 visit holds 74 pictures of Santa and his elves along the sand, posted in the city's special events photo albums.
Because Santa keeps moving north, the giveaway works as a short walk along the beach rather than a seated visit, which suits toddlers and strollers on the sand path.
faq: When is Santa on the Beach in Fort Lauderdale?
At Fort Lauderdale Beach Park, 1100 Seabreeze Blvd, Fort Lauderdale, FL 33316.
Santa and his elves head north along Fort Lauderdale Beach from the beach park.
Candy canes, as part of the city's traditional December candy giveaway.
The City of Fort Lauderdale Parks and Recreation department.
The city's event page prints no price for the giveaway.
Where can we see photos from past years?
The city's special events photo albums page holds a gallery from the 2025 visit.
